description: anonymised shape of real callers: per env yaml boolean allow failing

inputs_json.environments-yml:
- environment: "env-a"
  runs-on: "runner-a"
  pr-comment-group: "group-a"
  url: https://example.com/a
  extra-envs-yml: |
    ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" # comment
    ARM_CLIENT_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003" # comment
- environment: "env-b"
  runs-on: "runner-b"
  pr-comment-group: "group-a"
  allow-failing-terraform-operations: true # comment
  url: https://example.com/b
  extra-envs-yml: |
    ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004" # comment
    ARM_CLIENT_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005" # comment
- environment: "env-c"
  runs-on: "runner-c"
  pr-comment-group: "group-a"
  url: https://example.com/c
  extra-envs-yml: |
    ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006" # comment
    ARM_CLIENT_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000007" # comment
inputs_json.extra-envs-yml:
ARM_USE_OIDC: true
ARM_USE_AZUREAD: true # comment
ARM_TENANT_ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
inputs_json.pr-auto-merge-limits-yml:
plan-max-count-add: 0
plan-max-count-change: 0
plan-max-count-destroy: 0
plan-max-count-import: -1
plan-max-count-move: -1
plan-max-count-remove: 0
